mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting position information to the arm was most worthwhile because it brought the chapter’s separate sensory and motor paths together and explained how the arm can be guided without watching it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining light with the eyes felt fairly predictable, though the picture’s change from light rays to a nerve signal made the result useful.

surprise.text: The segmented wrapping of motor fibers, with small gaps and unwrapped muscle endings, was a useful detail I had not expected from the initial item names alone.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt especially arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave a clear reason for each connection.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter to see how the guided arm is used in a larger body system. The connections were clear, although the choices in this chapter were mostly predictable.
